author: Home Repair Tutor
description:
Large porcelain tiles are the best option for bathroom floors. Low maintenance and fast installation are two big reasons. But proper installation is important. 

I wipe off the back of the tile and dampen it with a sponge. I also apply thin-set to the back of the tile and fill the DITRA cutback cavities with thin-set mortar. When I set the tile, I move it back and forth to collapse the thin-set mortar. I also tamp the tile with a rubber mallet. 

The final step is to remove any thin-set that gets between the shower curb and tile. I do the same thing at the walls and simply use a toothbrush. For more bathroom renovation tips, visit me at homerepairtutor.com
title: Large Floor Tile Tips - #tileflooring #porcelaintile #bathroomupgrade
